project.name: Rain's Flexible Modules — Warps
project.description: Named places anybody can be sent to, with a menu to pick one from and a warm-up to stand through. The places themselves are RainsCore's — a warp is a POI of kind "warp", so a ghast line can fly to one and deleting a world takes its warps with it. What is here is who may use which, how a server groups them, and the screens.
